Breath taking Scenaries
Songbird Safari Lodge strategic location
makes us the most popular place to start
your Queen Elizabeth adventure. The campsite
oversees the Kazinga channel and different
ecosystems ranging from the thick
underground rain forest that acts as a
habitant for different wildlife species
including elephants, buffalos and many more.
Spacious living accomodation
We are the most popular budget accommodation
within the park with a variety of
accomodation services that cater for a
number of guests ranging from one individual
,couples, to large families. We pride
ourselves in providing the best
accommodation facilities at an affordable
cost.
Top of the line relaxation
The scenic view and tranquile environment at
Songbird Safari Lodge provides our guests
with the best form of relaxation and
meditation away from the outside world. We
provide services like chimpanze
tracking, boat cruises on the kazinga channel
that give a whole new experience to all our
guests that come to Songbird Safari Lodge.
Quality Entertainment
At Songbird Safari Lodge we pride our selves
in also providing a wide range of services
that keep our guests engaged and entertained
for example cultural trips that will have
you associating with various tribes and
engage in activities like music, dance and
drama from the Kikorongo Women Community and
so much more.

About us
Know us better
Songbird Safari Lodge, a home of birds where by
when you wake up in the morning you will hear
them singing sweet love songs, we choose the
songbird because of its continual movements, it
never gives up on its journey, so travel with
Songbird Safari Lodge Katunguru Uganda, we're in
the middle of Queen Elizabeth national park the
home of big the five,we are bordering kazinga
channel where you can do the best bird watching
along the channel, and next door is kyambura
gorge where you can track chimpanzee, you can
view all the animals because Songbird Safari
Lodge is the home of impala's , buffalos,
elephants and many more, we're hospitable to our
clients, you will feel at home while you're with
us, at Songbird you will have peace of mind.
Songbird Safari Lodge strategic location makes
us the most popular budget accommodation within
the park, a place to start your Queen Elizabeth
adventure.
Exquisite cuisine and dining
Enjoy food from the best chefs with
excellent services. Our restaurant and
bar offer the best meals and drinks
consisting of local and continental
dishes all at unbeatable prices.
